concerns.text: The plan relies on a *synthetic fallback* `IL‑Benchmark‑local.zip` as the source of CCSD(T)/CBS reference interaction energies (see “The spec notes the lack of an open CCSD(T)/CBS dataset … synthetic fallback is used”). This dataset is **not** a genuine high‑level ab initio benchmark, violating FR‑001 which requires benchmarking against real CCSD(T)/CBS data. Using a synthetic placeholder prevents the study from answering the core research question about DFT‑D3 transferability.
